metadata_description: Accessibility direction per navigation, forms, motion e responsive layouts.
title: UN product che remains usable in real conditions
description: Practicora aims per keyboard accesso, readable contrast, responsive layouts e motion che respects utente preferences.
section_1_description: Interactive controls use visible concentrazione states e predictable tab order.
section_2_description: Dense views reorganize per smaller screens instead di hiding essential azioni.
section_3_description: Reduced-motion preferences limit decorative movement while preserving useful state changes.
section_4_description: Accessibility è treated as ongoing product work e should essere tested con real utenti e assistive technologies.
